scope: Actual TypeScript decoder and quality helpers on frozen public benchmark tensors/pixels in Node. No model rerun, native camera, or accuracy promotion.
limitations: The benchmark replaced precheck-rejected model outputs with zeros; those rows establish image-quality/pipeline parity only, not actual model-output decoder parity.
Agreement between decoders does not imply that their predicted words are correct.
Node replay does not establish physical-camera or native TFLite inference equivalence.
